title: Use map and lambda to double numbers 1 through 1. (Challenge 1)
description: Use map and lambda to double numbers 1 through 1.
hints: Identify the main Python concept: lambda, map, filter.
Write a small, direct solution and check indentation.
Compare each printed line with the expected output.
solution:
result = list(map(lambda x: x * 2, range(1, 2)))
print(result)
explanation: This exercise practices lambda, map, filter. The solution uses the relevant Python feature and prints the required result.
commonMistakes: Forgetting correct indentation or punctuation.
Printing extra text that changes the expected output.
